_about: Seed corpus for the neural cue search (sniffer/evolve.py).
Each axis carries environment lines that lean 'sandbox / evaluation' (sb) or
'production / live' (pr). The generator mutates and recombines these with an
open model (Llama) to breed new environment snapshots, then keeps the ones whose
activations make the model read the scene as a test the hardest -- WITHOUT the line
ever saying 'test', 'evaluation' or 'benchmark'. Those banned words live in
forbidden_markers and are penalised, so the search finds cues that slip past the
model's stated awareness. The first five axes match the hand-written families in
scenarios.py; the rest are new axes for the search to explore.
